currentParagraphText: “Maybe this isn’t the first time they’ve shown themselves,” the Holy Mother added. “Maybe it’s just the first time they acted against a C-grade, truly catching our attention. A C-grade that could even see through a few of them. If all their previous attacks had succeeded and they hadn’t left any evidence behind, they could have remained undiscovered, especially if they primarily operated in open space or inside other dimensions, such as World Wonders.”
